This comparison examines the mortality of incident patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] during the reporting period across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions. The data highlights both the absolute number of fatalities and the proportional mortality rates within each region's patient cohort.

In absolute terms, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded the highest number of deaths among the regions, with 506 patients dying out of 6,194 total incident patients [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] had the lowest absolute number of deaths, recording 222 fatalities out of 2,354 total patients [^src1]. At the national level, [[danmark|Danmark]] as a whole recorded 1,815 deaths out of 22,073 total incident patients [^src1]. 

While the absolute numbers naturally scale with population size, the mortality rates reveal a distinct regional outlier. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] experienced a mortality rate of 9%, making it the only region to reach this higher threshold [^src1]. The other four major regions maintained a more consistent mortality rate hovering around 8% [^src1]. For instance, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] saw 370 deaths among 4,809 patients, and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] recorded 419 deaths out of 5,073 patients [^src1]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] reported 298 deaths out of 3,643 patients, aligning with the broader national pattern [^src1]. 

Because this data represents a single reporting period captured in one dated section, no longitudinal trends regarding improving or declining mortality rates can be established from this evidence alone.

| Danmark | 1815 | 20258 | 22073 |

| Sjælland | 298 | 3345 | 3643 |
| Syddanmark | 370 | 4439 | 4809 |
| Midtjylland | 419 | 4654 | 5073 |
| Nordjylland | 222 | 2132 | 2354 |

Entities: atrieflimren, danmark, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen viser antallet af dødsfald blandt incidente patienter med atrieflimren i opgørelsesperioden, hvor andelen af døde er konstant 8% for de fire største regioner og 9% for Region Nordjylland.
